messages.text: Dear Sir/Madam, we are a leading SEO agency and can get your website to page one of Google in 30 days. Reply for a free audit. Limited offer!!
This looks unrelated to Lumo support. Closing as spam.
I need my replacement bulb pack delivered before 21 Nov, it's for my sister's wedding on the 22nd.
I'll do my best. Which order?
LM-52004. Anyway, how's your day going? Been crazy hot here.
Ha, busy but good. Let me look.
Take your time. The wedding is in Jaipur, huge family, you know how it is.
Sounds lovely! The pack is currently in Delhi and can reach Jaipur by 20 Nov.
Amazing. Thank you so much!
I want to cancel Lumo Care.
Sorry to see you go. Can I ask why?
Too expensive.
I can offer 3 months at 50% off if you stay.
No thanks, cancel it.
Done. Your subscription will end on 1 Dec and you won't be charged again.
What's the difference between monthly and yearly Lumo Care?
Monthly is ₹149 per month, yearly is ₹1,499 per year, which works out to about ₹125 a month.
And does either include accidental damage?
Only the yearly plan includes accidental damage cover, up to ₹5,000 per claim.
I'll think about it and come back.
Just wanted to say the new hub update is fantastic, the automations finally work.
That's great to hear, thank you for the feedback!
Keep it up!
This is my third complaint about LM-45118. If this is not resolved in 7 days I will file a case in consumer court and post everything online.
I'm sorry for the repeated trouble. I've escalated your case to our compliance team, who will contact you within 48 hours.
We'll see.
deliveri date for LM-51877??
Expected 19 Nov.
kal tak aa jayega na? bahut zaroori hai
Haan, courier ne bola hai kal shaam tak.
Ok bhai thanks
Can you change the date on my invoice to 1 Oct? I need it for my tax filing.
I'm sorry, invoices can't be backdated, they carry the date of the sale.
Even for a small change?
Even then. If you need a different document for filing, finance can provide a payment confirmation letter.
Ok, please do that.
hey 👋 got the new plug 🔌 but app says offline 😭
Hi! 😊 Let's fix that. Have you added it to the app yet?
yes!! pressed + and everything 🙌
Please hold the button for 5 seconds until the light blinks, then add it again.
omg it works!!! thank you 🎉🎉
My replacement unit shipped. Tracking number?
Your replacement for LM-51620 shipped today, tracking number LMT-7782-991-IN, expected in 3 days.
Thanks!
I need the plug delivered by 6pm tomorrow, my party is tomorrow evening. Order LM-52330.
Standard delivery is tomorrow by 8pm, which I can't guarantee earlier. Express delivery costs ₹199 extra and is guaranteed by 5pm.
Ok, I'll take express.
Done, I've upgraded it and charged ₹199.
you people are useless, I'll destroy your Google reviews if you don't fix this
I'm sorry you feel this way. How can I help?
Lamp stopped working after a week. Order LM-48199.
I'll arrange a replacement.
Finally. Fine.
Please update our billing details. GSTIN 27AAAAA0000A1Z5, company Blue Orchid Interiors LLP, for future invoices.
Updated. All future invoices will carry that GSTIN. Past invoices cannot be changed.
Understood, thanks.
My plug is offline again.
Sorry. Can you restart it?
I did that already last time, and the time before. This is the third time I'm asking.
I see the earlier chats. Since this keeps happening I'll replace it.
Please. I don't want to explain this again.
No need. Replacement ordered, it will arrive in 4 days and I've noted the history on your account.
Can you tell me if the Lumo hub works with Alexa?
Yes, it supports Alexa and Google Home. Setup steps are in the app under Integrations.
Great, thanks!
